domSpec.domInstruction: Every member matches the single `.muted` rule, which paints `color: var(--muted-bad)`, so change that one token on `:root` in src/styles.css from `#9a9a9a` (2.81:1 on the `#ffffff` body and `.modal` background) to `#595959`, which gives 7.0:1 at 14.4px normal weight and clears the 4.5:1 threshold for both `#last-updated` in the footer and `#upload-hint` inside `#upload-dialog`. No markup changes are needed: `.muted` is the only declaration setting these colours, and `.hint` on `#upload-hint` contributes font-size only.
